title: Remove elapsed wall-clock dependence from the terminal-carry retirement regression
outcome: Remove elapsed wall-clock dependence from the terminal-carry retirement regression
acceptance: The terminal-carry positive control keeps a known exact margin independent of elapsed time between the launch and first terminal read, while preserving nearby ambiguous-running and distant eligible controls.
Focused carried-check regressions pass and the change receives the required independent source review without reducing assertions or inflating timeouts.
